name: DRAM 3194
title: Dramaturgy Seminar
description: Practical work in dramaturgy. Students enrolled in the course have been assigned as dramaturgs for Connecticut Repertory Theatre productions or are undertaking alternative dramaturgical assignments such as performance curation or audience outreach projects. May be repeated for a total of 15 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Recommended preparation: DRAM 2141 and 3142.
